title: Data resource
description: Data DataSetMessage of Pub and Set Data (MG 8.3.4, MG 9.1.4) and the predefined DataSet Oi4Pv (MG 8.3.4, SF-077). The Payload of an application-defined DataSet is any JSON object whose fields are described by the Metadata of the same Source and Tag (REQ-RES-DATA-001, d7-test); Data has no predefined DataSetClassId. Rules of the rule layer: WriterGroupName = topic Filter (REQ-MSG-024, R-2), DataSetWriterName = topic Source (REQ-MSG-023, R-2).

Oi4Pv.$comment: REQ-RES-DATA-004 (MG 8.3.4, SF-077): the Oi4Pv DataSet has the mandatory field Pv and the optional fields Sv1 … Sv255 (no leading zeros), no other field; the values are described by its Metadata

WriterGroupName.$comment: REQ-MSG-024 (MG 8.2.3, MG 7.7): the WriterGroupName of a Data DataSetMessage is the Filter that addresses it: its Tag, one topic-encoded level

allOf.$comment: REQ-RES-DATA-004 (MG 8.3.4, SF-077): the DataSet with the Tag and WriterGroupName Oi4Pv (REQ-RES-DATA-003) is the Oi4Pv DataSet
